question: Add the terms imap, pop3, smtp and jmap to the interface vocabulary of scripts/dossier/schema.json, so that a mailbox or a sender reached over those protocols is not filed under unknown, webdav or rest alone?
why: email/migadu, email/purelymail, email/fastmail, email/mailo and email/mailbig are reached over IMAP, POP3 and SMTP and carry unknown; email/ovh-mx-plan, email/yandex-360 and email/zoho-mail carried webdav, a wrong term, and this unit set them to unknown (zoho-mail has no IMAP, POP or ActiveSync on its free edition); email/mailersend, email/postmark and email/sendgrid offer an SMTP relay beside the REST API and carry rest alone; email/fastmail also documents JMAP, an HTTP and JSON API at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session, which could map to rest or to a jmap term. The records name the protocols in interface_detail and tooling until the terms exist.
